evidence.title: Incident Report: Nairobi Ground Station
evidence.content: Whistleblower engineer Dr. Wanjiru Kamau has offered to hand HER STORY the full LOOM architecture and its client structure, in person, at the ground station where LOOM's relay infrastructure is hosted.

evidence.title: Dr. Wanjiru Kamau: Whistleblower Statement
evidence.content: "LOOM isn't a data tool anymore, if it ever was. It's a subscription service. There's a client committee — they call themselves 'the Underwriters.' They don't buy information. They buy outcomes."

evidence.title: LOOM Architecture Diagram
evidence.content: Full system diagram: intake (case selection), prediction (weak-point identification), execution (Amsel's field network), and billing (the Underwriters). See Network for the rendered org chart.

evidence.title: LOOM Ledger-Sync Subsystem — Code Audit
evidence.content: The ledger-reconciliation logic inside LOOM's billing subsystem is, uncredited, Bianca Ferraz's Case 002 macro — repurposed at scale, without her knowledge, to reconcile Underwriter payouts against engineered outcomes.

evidence.title: LOOM Scheduling Template
evidence.content: A case-briefing template used to draft new assignments. Opening line, verbatim: "Small one to open your file with. Should be quick." Renata has used this exact phrase since Case 001.

evidence.title: Visitor Log — Ground Station
evidence.content: A badge scan belonging to Viktor Amsel (biometric reference EVID-AMSEL-09), logged the week LOOM's architecture was last revised — run it through AFIS to confirm identity and placement, not just paperwork.

chat.text: I don't know anymore how much of what I've told you was mine. This last one — Case 010 — I'm assigning myself. No queue. No suggestions. Just you and me.

solution.successMessage: Amsel's aliases were never going to be enough on their own — a badge scan is. AFIS puts him physically at the facility the week the architecture changed, which means every alias across Cases 005 through 008 was the same person, standing in the same building, doing the same job under different names.

onDocument.c9_ev05: 'Should be quick.' Renata's exact words, Case 001, sitting inside a scheduling template she's never seen. She didn't write that line into LOOM. Somebody wrote it into her.

onFlag.ARCHITECTURE_UNLOCKED: The whole shape of it, finally, on one screen. Intake, prediction, execution, billing. Nine cases were nine line items.

onBookmark.c9_ev04: Bookmarked. Bianca Ferraz never knew her own macro ended up here.

narrativeBeats.onSubmitSuccess: Amsel doesn't run. He doesn't even seem surprised. 'Do you think you'd have found any of this,' he asks, 'if we hadn't wanted you to?'
